issue.title: queue_capacity_multiplier plumbing broke 16 runner test nodes (fakes lack the new required field)
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** `tests/test_run_agent_runner_wait_queue.py::test_queued_child_proceeds_after_identity_wait_barrier`

Commit 6beedbc11 ("feat(xprompt): add queue capacity multiplier plumbing") added a
required `queue_capacity_multiplier` field but did not update the test fakes.
`src/sase/axe/run_agent_runner.py:194` reads
`bootstrap.info.queue_capacity_multiplier`; the fake `_agent_info()` in
`tests/test_run_agent_runner_wait_queue.py` builds a `SimpleNamespace` without it,
and `AGENT_INFO` in `tests/_axe_run_agent_runner_retry_helpers.py` constructs
`AgentInfo(...)` without the new required positional arg.

Affected nodes (16 total, all deterministic):
- 4 failed in `tests/test_run_agent_runner_wait_queue.py`:
  `test_queued_child_proceeds_after_identity_wait_barrier`,
  `test_runner_forwards_blocking_wait_result_to_code_refresh`,
  `test_waiting_bead_claims_before_wait_and_promotes_before_execution`,
  `test_force_reuse_bead_marker_retains_wait_claim_without_release_marker`
  (`AttributeError: 'types.SimpleNamespace' object has no attribute
  'queue_capacity_multiplier'`).
- 12 collection errors across
  `tests/test_axe_run_agent_failed_fork_admission.py`,
  `tests/test_axe_run_agent_runner_deferred_workspace_flow.py`,
  `tests/test_axe_run_agent_runner_started_at.py`, and
  `tests/test_run_agent_runner_clan_summary_refresh.py`
  (`TypeError: AgentInfo.__new__() missing 1 required positional argument:
  'queue_capacity_multiplier'`).

Fix: add `queue_capacity_multiplier` to both fakes. No overlap with the
monitor_failed_count_leak diff, which touches none of these files.

Observed at HEAD `eba6b80d0` during monitored `just check` run `5gky1hb2f6rp`
(tool run `f612c7e28035a677677bc1779111476b`).

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic constructor/attribute mismatch, independent of load: AgentInfo.__new__() missing required positional 'queue_capacity_multiplier' at collection time on every worker, and AttributeError on SimpleNamespace at run_agent_runner.py:194 at runtime.

payload.entry: The required queue_capacity_multiplier field is present in both affected test fakes via commit fffdaeb3e. Re-ran wait-queue, failed-fork admission, deferred-workspace flow, started-at, and clan-summary test modules on current tree: 27 passed. The original collection and runtime failures no longer reproduce.

payload.description: Confirm parent epic AgentInfo fake failure was resolved
